tasks.title: Red team of the S0-CARRIER-ALIVE reading

handoff.objective: Falsify the interpretation, scope, and statistics of the S0-CARRIER-ALIVE reading: the claim under attack is 'at t=1 (full AES S-box, r=5, seed 531001), hit trials concentrate in the low-wt(e) tail of the candidate carrier e=(q0^q1)^(p0^p1) (14 hits at byte wt(e) 11-16 vs miss peak at 16; exact one-sided p_small <= 0.05), so the carrier is alive at t=1 and the ramp may now be spent'.
handoff.coordinator_prior:
>-
      I expect the gate/receipt work to survive (it is field-by-field identity), but I expect real pressure on FOUR joints: (1) TAUTOLOGY -- e is built from the same pair-differences that define W, so low wt(e) on hit trials may be a deterministic or near-deterministic consequence of W>=1 in this geometry rather than a discovery; if the carrier statistic is a function of the trial-map difference, the test may measure the instrument's definitions, not AES; (2) n_hits = 14 is a tiny sample -- the exact rational p helps, but check whether the low-tail concentration is driven by a handful of trials or by the specific 14 committed comparator seats; (3) single seed 531001 (comparator-side seed variance is on record, 14 vs 19 hits); (4) 'carrier is alive' language -- a correlation at one t-point is not the causal claim that the excess is carried by e; that claim needs the ramp decay (Stage 1) and is not yet measured. If the reading survives as 'low-wt(e) concentration at t=1, non-tautological, one seed', it survives; if joint (1) breaks it, the carrier statistic needs a redefinition before Stage 1 spends anything.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the S0-CARRIER-ALIVE interpretation overclaims beyond what one 14-hit arm at one seed can carry, and whether the carrier statistic is tautological.
